entries.claim: Statistics selection is semantically meaningful even without binding scarcity.
entries.realization_boundary: Census figures share one frozen Census realization. DMV baseline figures share an earlier target-100 DMV realization and must not be paired numerically with later DMV optimization.
entries.qualification: Empirical witnesses; not a universal PostgreSQL theorem.

entries.claim: Extended statistics impose measurable recurring ANALYZE maintenance work.
entries.realization_boundary: Independent isolated measurements on Census and DMV; coefficients are not shared.
entries.qualification: Aggregate first-order proxy, excluding creation, acquisition, concurrency, and per-candidate effects.

entries.claim: MCV clause consumption changes the estimated-clause state seen by FD semantics.
entries.realization_boundary: Conceptual composition is cross-realization; absolute objective values remain realization-local.

entries.claim: Constant ScalarArray IN/=ANY semantics can be added by bounded source-derived specialization.
entries.realization_boundary: Synthetic fixture and scalar regressions are separate from the real DMV payload realization.

entries.claim: Design-parametric replay reproduces native CE in the supported fragment.
entries.realization_boundary: Every comparison uses matched native/replay payload and physical state within its experiment.
entries.qualification: Raw/pre-clamp or explicitly reported native boundary; not full planner/CE replay.

entries.claim: General PostgreSQL CE coverage is outside the contribution.
entries.qualification: Explicit scope boundary, not an empirical result.

entries.claim: The solver uses exact replay move values and returns an audited neighborhood local optimum at workload scale.
entries.realization_boundary: Global exhaustive evidence applies only to the five-candidate Census instance and four restricted DMV instances.
entries.qualification: No full-instance global optimum or approximation guarantee.

entries.claim: Replay semantics expose exact move invalidation/dependency information.
entries.realization_boundary: Each trajectory comparison uses its own fixed payload and precedence.
entries.qualification: Control-work reduction does not imply universal wall-clock speedup.

entries.claim: Census provides a large sparse candidate-incidence regime.
entries.realization_boundary: Structural workload/candidate analysis; no payload realization.
entries.qualification: Sparse degree coexists with a giant component.

entries.claim: DMV provides a dense high-reuse IN-heavy regime.
entries.realization_boundary: Static workload audit; row count obtained from source data and later confirmed by load experiments.
entries.qualification: Only 36 structural pairs; not a large candidate-space scalability benchmark.

entries.claim: Real DMV replay matches native CE over the complete canonical workload.
entries.realization_boundary: One baseline target-100 payload realization, distinct from later optimization.
entries.qualification: 27,510 tested query/design comparisons inside the supported fragment.

entries.claim: Aligning the Census resource constraint with maintenance cost materially changes design and loss.
entries.realization_boundary: Direct comparison uses the same frozen Census evaluator/payload/precedence.

entries.claim: DMV optimization can leave budget unused instead of adding harmful/unhelpful objects.
entries.realization_boundary: New internally consistent target-100 realization; do not pair absolute loss with DMV baseline experiment.
entries.qualification: The 50%, 75%, and 100% solutions coincide under the completed search and objective.

entries.claim: Incremental semantic evaluation remains useful under both sparse and dense incidence.
entries.realization_boundary: Cross-workload comparison is structural/control-work, not a paired runtime benchmark.
entries.qualification: Census mixed implementation did not improve wall-clock time; DMV reports avoided replay operations, not an end-to-end speedup.

entries.claim: Composition-aware optimization restores useful FD reachability.
entries.realization_boundary: Use consumption counts and qualitative mechanism behavior across realizations; do not pair their absolute objectives.
entries.qualification: One selected DMV FD failed to materialize fresh; all 11 materialized FDs consumed.

entries.claim: The final Census design physically realizes and fresh replay matches native PostgreSQL.
entries.realization_boundary: Frozen optimization payload versus one fresh deployed ANALYZE is explicitly paired.
entries.qualification: One deployment; local optimum; environment-specific cost model.

entries.claim: The final DMV design physically realizes and fresh replay matches native PostgreSQL.
entries.realization_boundary: Fresh-side values are authoritative; frozen per-query numerical vector is absent.
entries.qualification: Do not report a paired frozen-to-fresh per-query drift distribution.

entries.claim: Payload realization drift is distinct from semantic replay error.
entries.realization_boundary: Census has paired/repeated numerical evidence; DMV has fresh and structural evidence only.
entries.qualification: Do not infer design-ranking stability from one-design variability.

entries.claim: Maintenance coefficients and prediction accuracy are environment-specific.
entries.realization_boundary: Cost-model calibration and deployment sanity checks are separate measurements within each workload environment.
entries.qualification: Report Census 7.20% and DMV 21.4295% deployment prediction errors.
